character.bible: Pip is a small young red panda with a round russet face, cream muzzle and eye patches, bright brown eyes, soft striped tail, and short tufted ears. Pip always wears the same sunny-yellow raincoat, teal scarf, and green rubber boots, with a tiny blue backpack. Appealing proportions and polished 3D family-feature animation, soft tactile fur, expressive eyes.
